popular.text: Nurse on Tacko Fall: “How can I put this? I just haven’t seen much… I just need to see him out there in some form, I think… There’s not much of a body of work.” Nurse said he thinks Fall can help the Sixers, but there isn’t a “body of work” right now to be judged.

popular.quoted_text: Asked Nick Nurse how he envisions piecing together 48 center minutes today with no Joel Embiid or Adem Bona: “We’re going to start Jabari at the five.” Says Dean Wade will also play center and LeBron James could, too.
